CREATE VIEW app.admin_storage_files WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
  SELECT
    x.kind,
    x.id,
    x.org_id,
    o.name AS org_name,
    x.lead_id,
    x.lead_firm,
    x.contractor_id,
    c.name AS cp_name,
    c.inn AS cp_inn,
    x.cat,
    x.src,
    x.link_kinds,
    x.source_kind,
    x.source_id,
    x.name,
    x.content_type,
    x.size_bytes,
    x.note,
    x.by_user,
    (SELECT e.short_name FROM public.employees e WHERE e.user_id = x.by_user) AS by_name,
    x.via,
    x.at,
    x.state,
    x.mem,
    x.erase_at,
    x.why
  FROM (
    SELECT 'file'::text AS kind, f.id, f.org_id, NULL::uuid AS lead_id, NULL::text AS lead_firm,
      f.contractor_id,
      CASE WHEN f.source_kind = 'lead' THEN 'lead' ELSE 'org' END AS cat,
      CASE f.source_kind WHEN 'contractor' THEN 'card' WHEN 'sent_file' THEN 'sent'
        ELSE f.source_kind END AS src,
      coalesce((SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT l.source_kind ORDER BY l.source_kind)
        FROM public.file_links l WHERE l.file_id = f.id AND l.org_id = f.org_id), '{}'::text[])
        AS link_kinds,
      f.source_kind, f.source_id, f.name, f.content_type, f.size_bytes, f.note,
      f.created_by AS by_user, NULL::text AS via, f.created_at AS at, 'ready'::text AS state,
      f.source_kind <> 'lead' AS mem, NULL::timestamptz AS erase_at, NULL::text AS why
    FROM public.files f
    WHERE f.state = 'ready'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'sent', s.id, s.org_id, NULL, NULL, s.contractor_id, 'sent', 'sent', '{}'::text[],
      'sent_file', NULL, s.name, s.content_type, s.size_bytes, s.comment, NULL, s.source,
      s.created_at, CASE WHEN s.status = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'new' END, true, NULL, NULL
    FROM public.contractor_sent_files s
    WHERE s.state = 'ready' AND s.status <> 'accepted'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'receipt', p.id, p.org_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'rcpt', 'subscription', '{}'::text[], NULL,
      NULL, p.receipt_name, p.receipt_type, p.receipt_bytes, NULL, p.created_by, NULL, p.created_at,
      'ready', false, NULL, NULL
    FROM public.subscription_payments p
    WHERE p.receipt_key IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'lead', d.id, NULL, l.id, l.firm, NULL, 'lead', 'lead', '{}'::text[], NULL, NULL, d.name,
      d.content_type, d.size_bytes, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.created_at, 'ready', false, NULL, NULL
    FROM public.platform_lead_docs d
    JOIN public.platform_leads l ON l.id = d.lead_id
    WHERE l.created_org_id IS NULL AND d.state = 'ready'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'trash', t.id, t.org_id, NULL, NULL, t.contractor_id, 'trash', coalesce(t.source, ''),
      '{}'::text[], NULL, t.file_id, t.name, NULL, t.size_bytes, NULL, t.deleted_by, NULL,
      t.deleted_at, 'trash', false, t.erase_at, t.why
    FROM public.file_trash t
    WHERE t.erased_at IS NULL AND t.restored_at IS NULL AND t.why <> 'extra'
  ) x
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = x.org_id
  LEFT JOIN public.contractors c ON c.id = x.contractor_id AND c.org_id = x.org_id
  WHERE app.is_platform_admin();
return (f) => tx.select(f).from(v).$dynamic();

CREATE VIEW app.admin_storage_check WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
  SELECT
    i.id,
    i.kind,
    CASE WHEN i.kind = 'extra' THEN i.key END AS path,
    coalesce(f.org_id, s.org_id, t.org_id, i.key_org_id) AS org_id,
    o.name AS org_name,
    coalesce(f.name, s.name, t.name, d.name) AS name,
    coalesce(f.contractor_id, s.contractor_id, t.contractor_id) AS contractor_id,
    c.name AS cp_name,
    CASE
      WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN CASE f.source_kind WHEN 'contractor' THEN 'card'
        WHEN 'sent_file' THEN 'sent' ELSE f.source_kind END
      WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'sent'
      WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'lead'
      ELSE t.source
    END AS src,
    coalesce(f.created_by, t.deleted_by) AS by_user,
    (SELECT e.short_name FROM public.employees e
      WHERE e.user_id = coalesce(f.created_by, t.deleted_by)) AS by_name,
    s.source AS via,
    coalesce(i.size_bytes, f.size_bytes, s.size_bytes, t.size_bytes, d.size_bytes) AS size_bytes,
    coalesce(i.object_at, f.created_at, s.created_at, t.deleted_at, d.created_at) AS at,
    t.attempts,
    t.last_error,
    i.first_seen_at,
    i.last_seen_at
  FROM public.storage_check_items i
  LEFT JOIN public.files f ON f.storage_key = i.key
  LEFT JOIN public.contractor_sent_files s ON s.storage_key = i.key
  LEFT JOIN public.platform_lead_docs d ON d.storage_key = i.key
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT x.org_id, x.name, x.contractor_id, x.source, x.deleted_by, x.size_bytes, x.deleted_at,
      x.attempts, x.last_error
    FROM public.file_trash x WHERE x.storage_key = i.key
    ORDER BY x.erased_at IS NULL DESC, x.deleted_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) t ON true
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = coalesce(f.org_id, s.org_id, t.org_id, i.key_org_id)
  LEFT JOIN public.contractors c ON c.id = coalesce(f.contractor_id, s.contractor_id, t.contractor_id)
  WHERE app.is_platform_admin() AND i.resolved_at IS NULL
    AND NOT (i.kind = 'extra' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.file_trash w
      WHERE w.storage_key = i.key AND w.erased_at IS NULL AND w.restored_at IS NULL));

CREATE VIEW app.admin_telegram_journal WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
  SELECT
    'outbox'::text AS src,
    o.id,
    'out'::text AS dir,
    o.created_at,
    o.chat_id,
    CASE WHEN o.chat_id < 0 THEN 'group' ELSE 'private' END AS chat_kind,
    o.org_id,
    g.name AS org_name,
    o.user_id,
    NULL::uuid AS contractor_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.chat_id < 0 THEN coalesce(tg.title, e.short_name, u.login::text)
      ELSE concat_ws(' ', coalesce(e.short_name, u.login::text), '@' || l.username)
    END AS recipient,
    o.kind,
    o.status,
    o.tries,
    o.last_error,
    o.text,
    CASE
      WHEN o.kind = 'setup_link' THEN 'link'
      WHEN o.kind IN ('code', 'relink_code') THEN 'code'
    END AS hide,
    o.payload,
    NULL::text AS button,
    o.message_id,
    NULL::bigint AS reply_message_id,
    NULL::text AS file_name,
    NULL::bigint AS file_size,
    o.sent_at,
    CASE WHEN o.kind = 'alert' AND o.dedupe_key LIKE 'alert:job:%'
      THEN split_part(o.dedupe_key, ':', 3) END AS alert_job
  FROM public.telegram_outbox o
  JOIN public.users u ON u.id = o.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.employees e ON e.user_id = o.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations g ON g.id = o.org_id
  LEFT JOIN public.telegram_links l ON l.user_id = o.user_id AND l.chat_id = o.chat_id
  LEFT JOIN public.telegram_groups tg ON tg.chat_id = o.chat_id AND o.chat_id < 0
  WHERE (SELECT app.is_platform_admin())
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'client'::text,
    m.id,
    'out'::text,
    m.created_at,
    m.chat_id,
    'client'::text,
    m.org_id,
    g.name,
    NULL::uuid,
    m.contractor_id,
    concat_ws(' · ', c.name, k.name),
    'client_' || m.kind,
    CASE
      WHEN m.message_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'sent'
      WHEN m.attempts >= 3 THEN 'error'
      ELSE 'pending'
    END,
    m.attempts::integer,
    NULL::text,
    NULL::text,
    NULL::text,
    m.payload,
    NULL::text,
    m.message_id,
    NULL::bigint,
    NULL::text,
    NULL::bigint,
    CASE WHEN m.message_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.created_at END,
    NULL::text
  FROM public.contractor_telegram_messages m
  JOIN public.contractor_telegram_links k ON k.id = m.link_id
  JOIN public.contractors c ON c.id = m.contractor_id
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations g ON g.id = m.org_id
  WHERE (SELECT app.is_platform_admin())
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'inbox'::text,
    i.id,
    'in'::text,
    i.created_at,
    i.chat_id,
    i.chat_kind,
    i.org_id,
    g.name,
    i.user_id,
    i.contractor_id,
    coalesce(
      CASE
        WHEN i.user_id IS NOT NULL
          THEN concat_ws(' ', coalesce(e.short_name, u.login::text), '@' || l.username)
        WHEN i.contractor_id IS NOT NULL THEN concat_ws(' · ', c.name, i.sender)
        WHEN i.chat_kind = 'group' THEN coalesce(tg.title, i.sender)
      END,
      i.sender,
      ''
    ),
    'in_' || i.kind,
    i.status,
    0,
    i.error,
    i.text,
    i.hide,
    NULL::jsonb,
    i.button,
    NULL::bigint,
    i.reply_message_id,
    i.file_name,
    i.file_size,
    NULL::timestamptz,
    NULL::text
  FROM public.telegram_inbox i
  LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = i.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.employees e ON e.user_id = i.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations g ON g.id = i.org_id
  LEFT JOIN public.telegram_links l ON l.user_id = i.user_id AND l.chat_id = i.chat_id
  LEFT JOIN public.contractors c ON c.id = i.contractor_id
  LEFT JOIN public.telegram_groups tg ON tg.chat_id = i.chat_id AND i.chat_kind = 'group'
  WHERE (SELECT app.is_platform_admin());

CREATE VIEW app.admin_users WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
  SELECT
    u.id,
    u.login::text AS login,
    u.org_id,
    o.name AS org_name,
    e.full_name,
    r.name AS role_name,
    u.is_platform_admin,
    u.last_login_at,
    u.blocked,
    coalesce(e.active, true) AS employee_active,
    u.created_at,
    coalesce(h.at, u.updated_at) AS updated_at,
    e.created_by,
    h.actor_user_id AS updated_by,
    (SELECT c.short_name FROM public.employees c WHERE c.user_id = e.created_by) AS created_by_name,
    (SELECT c.short_name FROM public.employees c WHERE c.user_id = h.actor_user_id) AS updated_by_name,
    u.version
  FROM public.users u
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = u.org_id
  LEFT JOIN public.employees e ON e.user_id = u.id
  LEFT JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = e.role_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT x.at, x.actor_user_id
    FROM (
      (
        SELECT a.at, a.id, a.actor_user_id FROM public.audit_log a
        WHERE a.org_id = u.org_id AND a.entity = 'user' AND a.entity_id = u.id::text
        ORDER BY a.at DESC, a.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
      UNION ALL
      (
        SELECT a.at, a.id, a.actor_user_id FROM public.audit_log a
        WHERE a.org_id = u.org_id AND a.entity = 'employee' AND a.entity_id = e.id::text
        ORDER BY a.at DESC, a.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
    ) x
    ORDER BY x.at DESC, x.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) h ON true
  WHERE app.is_platform_admin();
